title: Plancherel identity for finite abelian groups
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $f,g:G\to\mathbb{C}$. Their uniform inner product equals the sum over all additive characters $\chi$ of $G$ of the complex conjugate of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\chi$, multiplied by the Fourier coefficient of $g$ at $\chi$.
